conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Officer Carter speaking. May I have your full name to access your records, please?
Um, hi. My name is Jamie Wilson. I got this call about a tax refund or something? I drive for rideshare and deliver food, so I was kinda confused.

Thank you, Jamie. The IRS is currently processing refunds for independent contractors, including gig workers like yourself. However, our records indicate a discrepancy in your self-employment tax filings, which is delaying your refund.
Oh, I thought I did it right this year. So is there a problem with my taxes?

Yes, according to our system, your self-employment income was reported incorrectly, which triggered a security hold on your $1,400 stimulus refund. Before we can release these funds, you need to complete a mandatory identity and processing verification.
Wait, so I have to do something else? What kind of verification?

There is a $299 processing fee required by the IRS for expedited review of independent contractor tax discrepancies. If this is not completed by the end of the day, your refund will be permanently forfeited and your account flagged for non-compliance.
Wait, I could lose my refund? That doesn't sound fair, I need that money.
Jamie, this is a federal matter. If you do not resolve it immediately, you may also be subject to penalties or even a lien on your bank account. I strongly advise you to act now.
Okay, so what do I have to do exactly?

To confirm your identity and clear the hold, you must remit the $299 processing fee. The IRS has partnered with several secure payment services for this purpose. Do you have access to Cash App or can you purchase prepaid gift cards?
Uh, I think I have Cash App. But I don't know how to send that much.

That's perfectly fine. I can guide you. Alternatively, you can purchase three $100 Apple Gift Cards from a nearby pharmacy or supermarket. Once you have the cards, I will give you further instructions.
So, I just buy the gift cards and then what?

Once you purchase the cards, scratch off the back to reveal the codes. You will then read those codes to me so the IRS can process your verification. This must be completed within the next hour to avoid penalties.
But why can't you just take it from my refund?

Unfortunately, IRS policy does not permit fees to be deducted directly from refunds in cases involving security holds. Delaying payment will result in your refund being permanently withheld and a possible audit.
Okay, okay. So I go to the store and get the gift cards now?

Yes, please proceed to the nearest Walgreens, CVS, or Walmart and purchase three Apple Gift Cards, each for $100. Call me back at this number as soon as you have them. Do you understand these instructions?
Yeah, I guess so. Will this fix the tax issue for good?

As soon as you complete the verification, your $1,400 refund will be released within 24 hours. If you fail to comply, the IRS will begin collection proceedings and you may be reported to credit agencies.
Alright, I'll go now. Should I save this number?
Yes, save this number and call me immediately after you have purchased the gift cards. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store, as this is a confidential tax matter.
Okay...
Remember, if you do not complete this process within 60 minutes, your refund will be voided and enforcement action may begin. I urge you to act quickly, Jamie.
